sources.snippet: EfficientFormer is a vision transformer model that can classify images from the Imagenet dataset. This is based on the implementation of EfficientFormer found here. This repository contains scripts for optimized on-device export suitable to run on Qualcomm® devices. More details on model performance across various devices, can be found here. sources.snippet: EfficientFormer Model transformer with an image classification head on top (a linear layer on top of the final hidden state of the [CLS] token) e.g. for ImageNet. This model is a PyTorch nn.Module subclass. Use it as a regular PyTorch Module and refer to the PyTorch documentation for all matter related to general usage and behavior.
